title: 세 발짝
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A string section provides legato pads and counter-melodies. The bass guitar enters with melodic, sliding transitions between root notes. Drums feature a soft kick and a rimshot on the backbeat. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, in the key of G Major. The vocal performance uses a mix of chest voice and breathy delivery, with subtle vibrato on sustained notes. Production includes high-fidelity reverb on the vocals and piano.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano playing sustained chords, soft string pads]

[Verse 1]
[baritone male vocals, breathy delivery]
잠그는 소리가 [piano melodic fill]
공항을 채워가
너는 뒤에 서서
발걸음만 세어 [bass guitar enters with a slide]
입국장 유리문
먼저 서는 이유를
나도 모르겠어
아니 알고 있어 [rimshot on backbeat]

[Chorus]
[full string section swells, kick drum enters]
돌아보면 안 되는데
유리문엔 네가 비쳐
웃고 있는 건지
울고 있는 건지
모른 채로 가야 해
